title: The Real Cost of Every Purchase in Hours
hook_text: THAT SHIRT COSTS HALF A DAY

beats.say: That $100 shirt doesn't cost $100. It costs half a day of your life.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a price tag hanging on dark fabric, sodium light, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Before you buy it, turn the price into hours of your work.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a solitary desk lamp cutting through deep blue hour shadows in an empty room.

beats.say: Step one. Work out your exact take-home pay per hour once.
beats.visual: Close-up of a pen resting on a blank white sheet of paper on a dark wooden table, cold fluorescent light.

beats.say: Divide your monthly take-home pay by the total hours you spend working.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary commuter walking across a wet asphalt underpass at night.

beats.say: Step two. Divide the price of that new item by your actual hourly take-home rate.
beats.visual: Silhouette of hands tapping a calculator on a stark metal surface, backlit by single practical light.

beats.say: Is that item really worth the exact hours you spent earning it?
beats.visual: High angle shot of a lone coffee cup sitting on a massive concrete bridge at dusk.

beats.say: Step three. Ask whether the thing is worth those hours of labor.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of clock hands ticking in a dark room, illuminated by faint blue light.

beats.say: Most people assume a $200 purchase is just $200 from an abstract account.
beats.visual: Wide shot of empty highway at night under flickering amber streetlamps.

beats.say: The truth is you traded actual living time for that specific object.
beats.visual: Close-up of rain-slick street reflecting a single red taillight in the dark.

beats.say: Money is just stored human time sitting in your wallet.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a hand sliding a dark card into a slot under cold fluorescent lighting.

beats.say: When you price things in hours, impulse buys suddenly lose their shiny appeal.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete pillar stretching up into a foggy night sky.

beats.say: Calculate your last impulse buy right now and test this rule today.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person walking away down a long, narrow corridor lit by a single overhead bulb.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a dark horizon line under a pale blue dawn sky.

caption: Turn any price into hours worked and watch your impulse spending vanish. #money #personalfinance #smartmoney #budgeting #wealth
description: Learn the three-step rule to price purchases in hours of your life instead of dollars, cutting impulse buys instantly.
